reviews.text:
(Updated) Great app!. Really like this app, but it desperately needs an easier way to edit habits for past dates. Presently, if I want to add 3 tasks I completed yesterday, that requires 15 taps! WAY too cumbersome. The best option would be to simply allow users to tap on the date for the applicable habit under the “(Current Month)” page. The fact that this page doesn’t have that functionality is baffling. Alternatively, a swipe gesture could be added to the “Today” page. Where swiping right takes you to an identical page for Yesterday, then the previous date. Even if users could only go back in time 2-3 days using this method, that would be enough. With one of these features, this is definitely a 5-star app!

(Updated to 4 stars - thank you devs for the response! Turns out there’s a super helpful shortcut via long-pressing the habit on the home page to mark yesterday as complete. That solves 90% of the struggle here! 5 stars once the calendar updates are complete. Really glad I’ve found a habit tracker I can stick with!)

reviews.text: Love this app. This is the best App I’ve been able to find to keep me on track. It helps me keep focused on my daily exercise, my eating habits, like NOT eating things that I love that are bad for me and how many days I can go without eating CANDY. I’m a diabetic and it’s real challenge for me. There are so many things in my life that I do that I want to stop doing and things that I don’t do that I want to start doing and I keep track of with this app. Needless to say I really like the app and I use it every single day to log my results with just a tap. I’ve been trying for 20 years to lose weight and this app has given me the extra help that I have needed to accomplish my weight loss goal. I finally got under 200 pounds by setting a goal not to eat after 6 PM, not to eat candy and things like that. The simple process of setting a goal and checking off every day showing that you’ve done what you planned really helps. I know that there are other good apps out there to accomplish the same thing but this one really works for me. I like simple, straightforward, uncomplicated easy to use apps that accomplishes my desired results. Oh, I don’t usually do reviews but I like this app so much that I went on and on and on. Sorry! Thoughtfully designed, useful app. I have been using this app daily since 9/27 to track both good and bad habits. It's well designed, useful, and my favorite app in the quantified self category. I would only ask for two changes. 

1. The app is designed around positive habits that you want to sustain (e.g. exercise). It does not cater to habits you want to quit. It's subtle, but things like "TO DO," streaks, and minimum goal of 1/wk instead of 0. It's not hard to work around that, but for example I'd rather not see "TO DO" next to bad habits. Just an empty state check box is enough for both good and bad habits. 

2. It would be cool to stack different habits on one graph for comparison. But again, it's not hard to work around by just exporting the data.
